stages.purpose: Learn balance, height and stationary foot support
Warm-start standing weights; learn alternating foot support and forward motion
Warm-start walking weights; track MediaPipe seven-second sidestep and recovery

failure_behavior: Retain checkpoint; repeat the same stage. Never mark an unpassed policy as ready.
native_cad_requirement: Native geometry evaluation requires all source meshes. --allow-proxy explicitly selects approximate geometry.
